name: Sodium C12-15 alkyl sulfate
description: Sodium C12-15 alkyl sulfate (CAS 68890-70-0 ) is an anionic surfactant derived from a blend of C12 to C15 fatty alcohols, offering a balanced profile of detergency and foaming suited to both consumer and industrial formulations. Its mid-chain alkyl distribution delivers effective soil removal and lather generation across a broad range of pH conditions and water hardness levels. In personal care, it functions as the primary cleansing agent in shampoos and body washes. It is also used in facial cleansers where controlled foam and skin compatibility are formulation priorities. Home care formulators use it in liquid dish soaps, hard surface cleaners, and all-purpose sprays where fast-acting grease removal is required. Industrial and institutional cleaning products rely on it for degreasing concentrated formulations used in food processing equipment and commercial kitchen applications. It provides reliable performance in heavy-duty environments. In textile and leather processing, it supports scouring and wetting operations, helping to remove oils and sizing agents from fiber substrates before dyeing. This ensures uniform treatment and high-quality finishes in manufacturing. Sodium C12-15 alkyl sulfate is supplied as an aqueous solution, typically at 28–30% active content, though higher-concentration grades are available depending on the manufacturer. Technical and cosmetic grades are the most common. Buyers should confirm active matter content, unsulfated matter limits, and sodium sulfate levels when evaluating supplier quality.
